purpose: Explain how role separation and acceptance gates structure agent work

required_facts.fact: Complex projects have tasks at different stages and need verification.
PM creates stories, criteria and test scenarios.
On-Call handles CI/CD failures after pushes.
Rejected QA work returns to SWE.
Final PM review checks alignment with the user story.
GitHub Issues or file trackers can record task state.

author_attribution: Explain Alexey's described methodology as an observed workflow, not a universal guarantee.
